  Requirement: The PR introduces a new workflow `.github/workflows/publish-sandbox-images.yml` and two new scripts `scripts/sandbox_image.sh` and `scripts/sandbox_images_publish.sh`. Per the established `tests/inventory_parity.py` contract, every workflow and script the repo ships must be registered in `docs/INVENTORY.md`, and every README.md / agents.md reference to such a file must be backed by a corresponding inventory entry. The PR description's "Testing" section claims "No new failures" but the `tests-release-and-log-analysis` job actually failed with 7 distinct `tests/inventory_parity.py` errors, and the aggregate `lint` job inherited the failure.
  Expected change site: `docs/INVENTORY.md` — add a `Workflows` entry for `.github/workflows/publish-sandbox-images.yml` and two `Scripts` entries for `scripts/sandbox_image.sh` and `scripts/sandbox_images_publish.sh`. The README.md and agents.md cross-references are already in the diff; the inventory entries are the missing counterpart.
  Evidence of absence: CI run 38028619768, job `tests-release-and-log-analysis` (PR head 00147cb) logs the seven specific parity failures: `docs/INVENTORY.md: Workflows: missing .github/workflows/publish-sandbox-images.yml`, `docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/sandbox_image.sh`, `docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/sandbox_images_publish.sh`, `README.md:1508: references .github/workflows/publish-sandbox-images.yml but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it`, `README.md:1495: references scripts/sandbox_image.sh but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it`, `agents.md:1214: references scripts/sandbox_image.sh but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it`, `agents.md:1223: references scripts/sandbox_images_publish.sh but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it`. The PR diff edits `README.md` and `agents.md` to reference all three new files but never touches `docs/INVENTORY.md`; the only way to satisfy the parity test is to add the three inventory entries. Cross-pollination confirms the same gap independently from four pass-1 reviewers (deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus), all with confidence 5.
